description: This file defines API endpoints related to user management in a web application, using FastAPI. It includes routes for listing users, retrieving a user by ID, and updating a user. It imports schemas and services from internal modules and depends on user roles for authorization.

methods.name: list_users( svc: UsersService = Depends(UsersService), _: None = Depends(require_roles([UserRole.admin])), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list all users, restricted to admin roles.

methods.name: get_user(user_id: str, svc: UsersService = Depends(UsersService))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a user by their ID.

methods.name: update_user( user_id: str, payload: UserUpdate, svc: UsersService = Depends(UsersService), _: None = Depends(require_roles([UserRole.admin])), )
methods.description: Endpoint to update user information, restricted to admin roles.
